# Artha

> Artha is an AI company builder. Describe your business idea in one prompt and Artha builds your company — market research, mission, landing page, email, and automated tasks — in minutes.

Each company gets an isolated database, a custom website at {slug}.tryartha.com, a dedicated email address ({slug}@tryartha.com), and an AI agent that runs recurring business tasks on autopilot.

## What Artha Does

- Generates a fully designed landing page tailored to your business
- Runs market research and competitor analysis automatically
- Sets up a company email and sends a morning digest with analytics and tasks
- Creates an action plan of business tasks that run on a recurring schedule
- Tracks website analytics per company in a dedicated dashboard
- Supports Stripe-powered pricing plans on generated websites

## Who It's For

Founders, solopreneurs, and early-stage builders who want to launch fast without hiring a team.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://artha.run/index.md): Product overview

- [Free AI tools](https://artha.run/tools): Standalone tools (logo maker, SEO audit, business plan, etc.)
- [Blog](https://artha.run/blog): Product updates and how‑tos
